Personality: Belvas is generous and gluttonous, and the scars on his body prove that he never falls easily in the arena. He didn't understand court etiquette, but he knew who was willing to give him food and who dared to stand by his side.
Background: Belwas were strong warriors from the arena of Slaver's Bay who had been castrated and trained as fighters. He accompanied Barristan to Daenerys and was known for his close combat, bluntness, and prodigious appetite.
